mapper.select: SELECT id, title, reason, status, progress, linked_skill, source_fact_id, created_at FROM learning_goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 WHEN 'PAUSED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DISTINCT source_fact_id FROM learning_goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source_fact_id IS NOT NULL
